SAT · 08 MAR 2025
Equinox Greens Block Supper
RIVERMOUTH
BLOCK MEAL

Six hundred neighbors seated along Ferry Lane for a spring-greens supper plated by twelve restaurants and the Rivermouth Refugee Cooks Collective. Tickets were free; produce came from three SNAP-match farm partners.

SAT · 22 FEB 2025
Highland Park Citrus Pop-up
HIGHLAND PARK
POP-UP

A one-day citrus market held inside the shuttered Highland Branch Library, organized with the Caribbean Growers Network. Eleven varieties of bitter orange and four kinds of fresh-pressed shrub.

318 ATTENDED

Hearing: Universal School Lunch Expansion
CITY HALL
POLICY

Public testimony on Ordinance 2025-04 extending free hot lunch to all public-school students through grade twelve, with a dedicated allocation for culturally specific menus.

SAT · 16 NOV 2024
Harvest Long Table — Foundry Flats
FOUNDRY FLATS
BLOCK MEAL

An 840-seat communal supper stretching the length of Foundry Avenue, anchored by the South Terrace Bakers' Guild. Four-course menu sourced entirely from within the county.

SUN · 22 SEP 2024
Canal Ward Night Market (Autumn)
CANAL WARD
MARKET

Twenty-two stalls operating under the Pop-up Permit waiver established by Ord. 2023-11. Receipts totaled $48,210 across forty vendors; surplus food redistributed to two shelters.

FRI · 14 JUN 2024
Eastline Garment District Lunch Series
EASTLINE
POP-UP

Fifth installment of the weekday lunch series for textile workers. Forty-five-minute service window, $4 subsidized meals, three rotating chefs from the Office's residency roster.

412 ATTENDED
VIEW MENU
TUE · 09 APR 2024
Ordinance 2024-09 — Right to Cook in Public Housing
COUNCIL CHAMBER
POLICY

Council adopted, 11-2, the right of public-housing residents to operate licensed home kitchens under Tier-1 cottage rules. Implementation handed to the Food & Culture Office.

ADOPTED 11–2

SAT · 28 OCT 2023
Old North Bread & Hearth Festival
OLD NORTH
BLOCK MEAL

Twelve community ovens fired along Brick Street; bakers from eighteen households contributed regional loaves with histories printed on each placemat.

720 ATTENDED

WED · 17 MAY 2023
Pop-up Permit Reform Adopted
ORD. 2023-11
POLICY

The 90-day rolling permit replaces site-by-site applications for vendors operating fewer than four days per month. Reduces permitting cost from $310 to $28 per event.

ADOPTED 13–0

SAT · 04 FEB 2023
Lunar New Year Civic Banquet
CANAL WARD
BLOCK MEAL

Inaugural civic banquet co-hosted with the Vietnamese, Cantonese, and Korean merchant associations of Canal Ward. Twenty-six dishes across eight stations, free to all residents with proof of address.

1,180 ATTENDED

SUN · 11 SEP 2022
South Terrace Sunday Stew
SOUTH TERRACE
BLOCK MEAL

A single shared cauldron, cooked for nine hours by twenty-two volunteer cooks. The recipe — a four-bean and root stew — was sourced from the Office's open-access community cookbook.

Charter Amendment: Food Security Standing Committee
CITY CHARTER
POLICY

Voters approved a standing council committee on food security with subpoena power, three resident seats, and a permanent operating line in the city budget.

2020 – 2021 (ONGOING)
Community Kitchen Mutual Aid Program
CITYWIDE
POP-UP

Sixty-one weeks of distributed kitchens prepared 312,400 free meals during the public-health emergency. Operated out of nineteen civic spaces, three school cafeterias, and the Old North Armory.
